_about: How cargo moves through a scenario: who carries each leg, and where cargo changes hands. Read by cargo_movement.py; see cargo_scenarios/README.md.

carriers._note: Commercial carriers never enter a weapons engagement zone (WEZ); the military may. Neither enters an area of denial. Speeds are nominal, the same 18 knots the route map uses.

*.knots.source: Nominal speed chosen for the demo, the same 18 knots the route map uses

handover._note: A handover port must be outside every WEZ and area of denial and rated one of these statuses for the class in cargo_capability.py. Of those, the one with the shortest military leg to the destination is used. window_nm decides when another port counts as a backup, and when a class's military leg counts as longer than the scenario's shortest.

countries.source: A list for the demo, not a statement of any agreement

handover.countries_note: The only countries whose ports may be handover ports, unless a scenario lists its own handover_countries. An illustrative list for the demo, not a statement of any agreement. Names as in ports.csv.

manifest._note: Illustrative quantities in short tons, used by every scenario that does not list its own cargo. They are for the demo, not planning factors.

*.source: Quantities chosen for the demo, not planning factors
